content: Web worker progress to UI best practice: scope every progress message with the requestId of the run that produced it; UI ignores progress whose requestId does not match the active request; always send a terminal event (done/error) so the UI can clear loading state; persist a run-state record so a UI that mounts mid-run can reconstruct state from storage instead of relying on live messages. Stuck-progress bugs almost always come from (a) progress emitted without requestId scoping so a stale run's progress overwrites the active one, or (b) no terminal event after completion/error so loading stays true.
